summary: Learn practical prompt design, AI output review, and workflow mapping in 5 days. Apply generative AI responsibly at work.
lede: Generative AI workplace training helps professionals use large language models for everyday drafting and summarization tasks. Participants learn to design prompts, check outputs for accuracy and relevance, and map suitable use cases into repeatable workflows with human review. The course also introduces privacy, confidentiality, and policy checks to help learners document responsible AI workflows for their roles.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use generative AI in day-to-day work and need practical methods they can apply immediately.
prerequisites: Familiarity with everyday digital work tools such as email, documents, spreadsheets, and shared drives is recommended. No coding, data science, or machine learning background is required. Participants should come prepared to discuss common work tasks that involve drafting, summarizing, researching, organizing information, or producing repeatable content, and they should be ready to test prompts and review AI outputs against workplace expectations. A laptop with internet access is required for hands-on exercises.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
